summary: Deswell Industries, Inc., a Macau-domiciled plastics products manufacturer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026 containing its annual meeting proxy statement. The AGM is set for November 10, 2026 in Dongguan, China, with a record date of September 11, 2026. Shareholders will vote on electing five directors and ratifying BDO China Shu Lun Pan as independent auditors for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The board recommends both proposals. No special-situation transaction, stake change, or strategic event is disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice and proxy solicitation.
